entries.exactPrompt: A single tiny fire-incident marker for Transport Dispatch, a child-friendly painted Miniature World educational map. Transparent PNG RGBA with absolutely clear surrounding pixels. Design to read instantly at 16–24 pixels: exactly one simple compact upright cluster of three rounded flame tongues, a warm orange outer flame with a small bright yellow inner flame and a thin deep rust outer contour. Rich matte hand-painted gouache on the silhouette, subtle pigment, no glossy emoji rendering. Front-facing stylised symbol for an overhead board-game map; shape is round and grounded with a flat short lower edge. Fill 80 percent of a square, centred with generous clear transparent padding. No smoke, sparks, faces, badge, ring, background, shadow, platform, text, people, objects or scenery. One complete shape, crisp alpha edge.
